title: Bare Uranium Sphere KENO-VI Criticality
description: ORNL SCALE CSAS6 KENO-VI criticality calculation for a bare highly enriched uranium metal sphere in vacuum boundary conditions.
code:
' Bare HEU Metal Sphere KENO-VI Criticality
=csas6
Bare HEU Metal Sphere Benchmark
v7.1-252
read comp
  u 1 den=18.74 1.0 300.0 92235 93.71 92238 6.29 end
end comp
read param
  npg=2000 gen=200 nsk=50
end param
read geom
  global unit 1
  sphere 1 8.741
  media 1 1 1
  boundary 1
end geom
read bounds
  all=vacuum
end bounds
end

title: Spent Fuel Decay Heat and Isotopics (ORIGEN)
description: ORIGEN nuclear transmutation and radioactive decay simulation tracking U-235 depletion and I-135/Xe-135 fission product poisoning through irradiation and cooling.

title: PWR 17x17 Pin-Cell Depletion (TRITON)
description: SCALE TRITON 2D lattice physics and depletion model of a 17x17 PWR UO2 fuel pin cell with Zircaloy-4 cladding and reflective mirror boundaries.
code:
' PWR 17x17 Pin-Cell Lattice Physics and Depletion
=triton
PWR 17x17 4.0 wt pct UO2 Pin Cell Depletion
v7.1-252
read comp
  uo2 1 den=10.41 1.0 900.0 92235 4.0 92238 96.0 end
  zirc4 3 den=6.56 1.0 600.0 end
  h2o 2 den=0.71 1.0 580.0 end
end comp
read celldata
  latticecell squarepitch pitch=1.26 2 fuelr=0.4096 1 cladr=0.475 3 end
end celldata
read param
  npg=2000 gen=250 nsk=50
end param
read geom
  global unit 1
  cylinder 1 0.4096 182.88 -182.88
  cylinder 2 0.4750 182.88 -182.88
  cuboid 3 0.63 -0.63 0.63 -0.63 182.88 -182.88
  media 1 1 1
  media 3 1 2 -1
  media 2 1 3 -2
  boundary 3
end geom
read bounds
  all=mirror
end bounds
end

title: Dry Cask Spent-Fuel Storage Shielding (MAVRIC)
description: Cylindrical spent nuclear fuel dry storage cask modeled in SCALE MAVRIC with homogenized fuel basket, carbon-steel canister, and concrete overpack.
code:
' Spent Fuel Dry Storage Cask Shielding Model
=mavric
Dry Cask Spent Fuel Storage Concrete Overpack
v7.1-252
read comp
  uo2 1 den=4.20 1.0 450.0 92235 1.2 92238 98.8 end
  ss304 2 den=7.92 1.0 380.0 end
  concrete 3 den=2.35 1.0 320.0 end
end comp
read param
  npg=4000 gen=150 nsk=30
end param
read geom
  global unit 1
  cylinder 1 82.0 200.0 -200.0
  cylinder 2 88.0 210.0 -210.0
  cylinder 3 160.0 260.0 -260.0
  media 1 1 1
  media 2 1 2 -1
  media 3 1 3 -2
  boundary 3
end geom
read bounds
  all=vacuum
end bounds
end

title: PWR Quarter-Assembly Array with Gadolinium Absorber Pins
description: 3x3 mini-assembly lattice combining standard UO2 fuel pins, gadolinium burnable-absorber pins, and a central water guide tube with companion burnup schedule.

' PWR Quarter-Assembly Lattice with Gadolinium Burnable Absorber Pins
=csas6
PWR 3x3 Mini-Assembly with UO2-Gd2O3 Pins and Guide Tube
v7.1-252

  uo2 1 den=10.41 1.0 900.0 92235 4.2 92238 95.8 end
  uo2 4 den=10.15 1.0 900.0 92235 3.0 92238 97.0 end
  zirc4 3 den=6.56 1.0 600.0 end
  h2o 2 den=0.71 1.0 580.0 end
end comp

  npg=3000 gen=250 nsk=50
end param

  unit 1

  cuboid 3 0.63 -0.63 0.63 -0.63 182.88 -182.88
  media 1 1 1
  media 3 1 2 -1
  media 2 1 3 -2
  boundary 3
  unit 2
  cylinder 1 0.4096 182.88 -182.88
  cylinder 2 0.4750 182.88 -182.88
  cuboid 3 0.63 -0.63 0.63 -0.63 182.88 -182.88
  media 4 1 1
  media 3 1 2 -1
  media 2 1 3 -2
  boundary 3
  unit 3
  cylinder 1 0.5610 182.88 -182.88
  cylinder 2 0.6020 182.88 -182.88
  cuboid 3 0.63 -0.63 0.63 -0.63 182.88 -182.88
  media 2 1 1
  media 3 1 2 -1
  media 2 1 3 -2
  boundary 3
  global unit 10
  cuboid 1 1.89 -1.89 1.89 -1.89 182.88 -182.88

end geom

end array
read bounds
  all=mirror
end bounds
end
